items.summary: Mississippi-born Wilson, who worked across folk, pop, R&B and country, was once dubbed America’s best singer Cassandra Wilson, the two-time Grammy-winning jazz singer, songwriter and producer has died. She was 70. Dubbed America’s best singer by Time magazine in 2001, Wilson was best known for her genre-bending voice, which expanded the boundaries of traditional blues-based jazz and worked effortlessly across folk, pop, R&B, country and beyond. He's since created three more CDs, distributed under the titles Seven Off The Two , Seaplane Dog , and The View From Tian Tian . items.title: Erykah Badu & The Alchemist Release New Album Before The World Blows Feat. Steve Lacy, Earl Sweatshirt, Thundercat, & More
items.summary: It's here! It exists! Way back in March 2025, Erykah Badu revealed that she was working on a collaborative album with rap production giant the Alchemist. This was obviously a big deal, since Badu hadn't released an album since 2010's New Amerykah Part Two (Return Of The Ankh) or an album-length work since the 2015 mixtape But You Caint Use My Phone . Badu and Alchemist released a single called " Next To You " last June, and then nothing. Finally, after more than a year, they returned with the single " Witch Doctor " earlier this month, and they announced that the LP finally had a release date.

items.title: Jeffrey Silverstein :: Patchouli
items.summary: Sometimes Jeffrey Silverstein uses words, delivering them in a low, Bill Callahan-esque drawl. Other times, he let’s the music do the talking. The most recent single from Silverstein’s forthcoming LP Doggone , the languid “Patchouli,” is a case of the latter. The tune is a patient blend of swelling synths, shimmering pedal steel from Rick Pedrosa, and Silverstein’s electric guitar, with a strutting disco undercurrent propelling it all.
